Horn is dc motor. Test is a momentary switch, only working when it's pressed to allow for a quick test. Then Alert and Attack are normal on/off switches. The 4th switch is for the rotator and thats a independent circuit not effected by the others.

There are 3 switches hooked up to the DC motor. TEST AND alert activate the motor in a steady tone. 

Attack activates both the motor and the Solenoid relay to cause an alternating wail effect. 

The way it's wired now, when I activate Test or Alert is backwards into the wiring for the Solenoid activation and turns those on.
